# Lagom

Lagom targets phones and tablets, keeping a conventional interface while adding visual and functional refinements. Its recorded features include a full-width file panel with multiline filenames, nested-folder indicators, Mac-like code blocks, classic quotes, a translucent nav bar and an inline title treatment.

![Lagom screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leslyecream/Lagom-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/IMG_20241009_134537.jpg)
